name: program-runtime.scenario-triage
purpose: Read one scenario's status, freshness, and a bounded log tail together and return advisory hypotheses (schema drift, port, dependency, stale artifact) so a supervisor triages a flagged scenario in one call.

scenario.description: The single scenario slug to triage.

tail.description: How many lifecycle log lines to read (bounded 1..200).

assumptions: the vrooli project control-plane API is reachable (it serves vrooli/scenario/status, /logs, /freshness)
the hypotheses are advisory keyword heuristics over the log tail, never a verdict; a caller confirms before acting
invariants: no binding with effect write or destructive is called; the scenario is never restarted or mutated
status is the one required read; freshness and logs are optional and degrade to a partial result when unavailable
the log tail is bounded to at most 200 lines
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path

bindings.note: artifact-freshness verdict; absence degrades to partial, never fails the triage
bounded lifecycle log tail for keyword classification; absence degrades to partial

status.note: ok when status was readable (an unhealthy scenario with hypotheses is a domain result, not a failure); partial when an optional read (freshness/logs) was unavailable; unavailable when the required status read could not be performed; failed on invalid input.

signals.attention: true when the scenario is not running or not healthy
signals.log_lines_read: count of log lines read for classification
signals.hypotheses: advisory list of {cause, evidence} where cause is schema_drift|port_conflict|dependency|permission|disk and evidence is the matching log line; empty when healthy or no pattern matched

fixtures.note: Triage a running scenario; status is readable so the result is ok (or partial if a log/freshness read is unavailable). A healthy scenario returns an empty hypotheses list.
An empty scenario slug is an invalid input the program reports as failed with class invalid_input before any read.
